text:
Jordan M: Evening handoff — I'm primary until 21:00 UTC. Current incident: read-replica latency alert is firing (PD). Client impact: intermittent slow reads, failovers working. Before I go, quick preflight on access and runbook pointers. Can everyone confirm the following? PagerDuty web + mobile, aws assume-role to Redwood-Oncall, Grafana prod org, and runbook link.

Priya S: I can take. Quick checks now. PagerDuty: mobile push + web both work (saw test notification). My PagerDuty role shows 'Responder' on escalation policy 'prod-db'.

Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Incident INC-746 created: "Read replica latency spike" — severity P2. PagerDuty alert sent to prod-oncall.

Jordan M: Priya — for AWS you should be able to `aws sso login --profile redwood-prod` then `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall --role-session-name oncall-session` if you need CLI. If you hit MFA, use your Okta push code. Grafana: link https://grafana.redwood.example.com/d/DB/replica-lag (view role: org:redwood-prod, team: infra-readonly or infra-oncall).

Priya S: Running the assume-role flow now.
Priya S: ok `aws sso login` succeeded, assumed `Redwood-Oncall` TTL 1h. I can access prod RDS metrics and the replica-lag dashboard. Grafana: I can view and annotate. PagerDuty: I can trigger an incident and acknowledge.

Sam K: Are we covered for secondary? I can be backup after 23:00 UTC but there’s a gap from 21:00-23:00 if Priya needs a break. Who's secondary tonight? @Erin L are you on backup?

Erin L: I'm secondary until 22:00 UTC, then Sam takes over. If Priya goes OOO earlier, ping me and I'll escalate. Also put DB infra on the incident if replica lag > 30s or error rates increase.

Jordan M: Runbook quick-links:
- runbook: https://wiki.redwood.example.com/runbooks/db-replica-lag
- quick triage steps: `check-replica-lag` dashboard -> if lag > 30s, check WAL shipping, then `psql` to replica for errors, then consider restarting replica (coord with infra).

Erin L: Note about permissions: If you need to open a temporary console on bastion, we use SSM: `aws ssm start-session --target i-0abcd1234efgh` — ensure your role has `ssm:StartSession`. For Grafana admin actions (create annotations, change panel time-range) you'll need `grafana-editor` role, not everyone has that.

Priya S: Confirmed SSM start-session works for me (ran a dry-run). I do NOT have grafana-editor role, but can view and annotate. If we need admin, tag @platform-team.

Jordan M: PagerDuty escalation check: if I ack and it re-triggers within 10m escalate to on-call-senior. Priya, you should verify your escalation path (Settings -> Escalation Policies -> prod-db). Also make sure you can access the incident details page and the attached logs (S3 presigned links).

Oncall Bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff checklist automated reminder: PagerDuty confirmed, AWS SSO/Assume-role confirmed, Grafana view confirmed, runbook link shared.

Priya S: All set on my end. I'll monitor the incident and start the 21:00 rotation. If latency crosses 45s or errors > 1% escalate to infra and set incident to P1. I'll call on-call-senior if that happens.

Jordan M: Passing primary to Priya at 21:00 UTC. Leaving notes in the incident: recent deploy at 20:30 may be related — keep an eye on canary logs (`/var/log/canary/` on canary hosts). Ping me if anything weird. :thumbsup:

Sam K: Copy. I'll be available for escalation and will join the bridge if asked.

Erin L: Thanks — logging handoff in the rotation doc. Good luck.

Jordan M: done. Priya — handing over.

Priya S: Taking it. Acknowledged.
